title: US x Iran ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran announced on April 7, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between the United States and Iran, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 7 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect. 

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the United States government and the government of Iran that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed two-week period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the United States government and the government of Iran. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump unilaterally extended the US-Iran ceasefire on April 21—initially agreed April 8 for two weeks via Pakistani mediation—until Tehran submits a unified proposal addressing the Strait of Hormuz blockade, nuclear program, and sanctions, while maintaining naval restrictions amid oil market volatility. As of April 28, talks have stalled over Iran's offer to reopen the vital shipping chokepoint in exchange for lifting the blockade and postponing nuclear discussions, which Washington rejected; Iran has used the truce to recover and redeploy buried weapons systems hit by US and Israeli strikes. Defense Secretary Hegseth warned of forceful response to any mining attempts, as EU and ASEAN urge sustained diplomacy amid humanitarian concerns in Gaza and rising global energy risks from UAE's impending OPEC exit. Upcoming Iranian proposal or breakdown could sway extension duration.

title: Fed decision in April?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's April 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for April 28-29, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their April meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

eventMetadata.context_description: Polymarket traders price a 99.8% implied probability of no change to the federal funds rate target range of 3½–3¾ percent at the April 28–29 FOMC meeting, reflecting consensus around solid economic expansion, somewhat elevated inflation per March data, and low job gains amid persistent uncertainty. The Committee's March statement held rates steady, with minutes released April 8 revealing some openness to hikes but no immediate action amid a wait-and-see policy stance ahead of potential leadership transition from Powell to Warsh. This skin-in-the-game positioning leaves scant room for shifts, though a surprise in tomorrow's April 29 announcement or Powell press conference—such as sharper inflation risks or labor weakness—could theoretically prompt a 25 basis point adjustment, albeit with negligible odds.

title: Trump Today: April 25
description: This is a market over what Donald Trump will do on April 25, 2026.

markets.question: Will Trump dance today?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump dances between 12:00AM ET and 11:59PM ET on April 25, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Dancing" is defined as deliberate, rhythmic body movement typically matched music or a beat, such as swaying, stepping, or coordinated hand or body motions. Casual gesturing, clapping, or incidental body movement will not qualify. Dancing without the presence of music or a beat will qualify.

AI-generated content, deepfakes, or altered footage will not be considered. 

Videos posted on his social media which were filmed outside this market's time frame will not qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

This market will resolve based on video.

markets.question: Will Trump say "Sleepy Joe" today?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump says the listed term on April 25, 2026. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No".

Plural and possessive forms of the listed term will count toward the resolution of this market regardless of context; however, other forms will NOT count.

Instances where the term is used in a compound word will count regardless of context (e.g., joyful is not a compound word for "joy," however, "killjoy" is a compounding of the words "kill" and "joy").

If this market requires a specified number of mentions of a person’s first or last name, a full-name mention will count as one mention (e.g., if a market is about “Joe / Biden 5+ times,” a mention of “Joe Biden” will count once).

A ‘mention’ will include any verbal mention which is recorded (audio or video) and publicly accessible.

Written usages of terms (e.g. Truth Social posts, written statements, etc.) will not count toward this market's resolution.

AI-generated audio or video will not count toward this market's resolution.

Videos posted on his social media which were filmed outside this market's time frame will not qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump headlined the White House Correspondents' Association Dinner on April 25, 2026—his first as president—at the Washington Hilton, but the event was abruptly disrupted around 9:47 PM by gunshots fired near the security perimeter outside the ballroom. Secret Service agents swiftly evacuated Trump, Vice President JD Vance, First Lady Melania Trump, and cabinet officials with no injuries reported; suspect Cole Tomas Allen, displaying anti-Trump sentiments, faces federal charges for attempting to breach with firearms and knives. Earlier, Trump delivered remarks after gaggled with press departing Palm Beach, Florida, following executive time and a crypto conference speech. Traders weighed these high-profile appearances against security risks, with the incident dominating coverage ahead of King Charles III's state visit April 27-30.

title: Israel x Hezbollah Ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the 10-day ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah announced on April 16, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between Israel and Hezbollah, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 16 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect.

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the Israeli government and Hezbollah that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed 10-day period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the Israeli government and Hezbollah. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: A fragile Israel-Lebanon ceasefire, initially a 10-day cessation of hostilities effective April 16 to enable peace negotiations, was extended by three weeks on April 24 following White House talks announced by President Trump, amid continued Israeli airstrikes on Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon and reciprocal Hezbollah drone attacks and rocket fire. Hezbollah officials, including MP Ali Fayyad, have rejected the extension as meaningless due to persistent violations, while Israel maintains operations in a reinforced security zone and has issued evacuation warnings beyond the buffer area. Israeli leaders set a mid-May deadline for a permanent deal under UN Resolution 1701 terms, including Hezbollah disarmament, with escalation risks if talks stall, shaping trader assessments of further extensions.

eventMetadata.context_description: Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. leads trader consensus at 49% implied probability for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination on Polymarket, fueled by his high public approval ratings and tangible Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) achievements, including drug price reductions, SNAP reforms prioritizing nutritious foods, and HHS restructuring that uncovered billions in fraud—developments highlighted in recent polls and administration updates through April 2026. Vice President J.D. Vance holds strong at 38.8% as the heir apparent to President Trump, bolstered by a March CPAC straw poll win, though his odds dipped amid reports of GOP donors favoring alternatives during an Iran conflict briefing. Secretary of State Marco Rubio surged to 21.8% on donor enthusiasm and his foreign policy profile, with 2026 midterms looming as a key test for early frontrunners.

title: Trump announces end of military operations against Iran by ...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the military publicly and officially announce that their military operations against Iran, initiated on February 28, 2026, have concluded by the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Qualifying statements must clearly indicate that the operation has ended. Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources or leaks will not qualify. 

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g. posts from his personal Truth Social account), will count. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if President Trump, the US government, or the military publicly and officially announce that their military operations against Iran, initiated on February 28, 2026, have concluded by the listed date (ET). Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Qualifying statements must clearly indicate that the operation has ended. Informal announcements, statements from unnamed sources or leaks will not qualify. 

Written public statements from Donald Trump (e.g. posts from his personal Truth Social account), will count. Videos posted on his social media accounts will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from the US government and/or its official representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US military operations against Iran, dubbed Operation Epic Fury and launched February 28, 2026, alongside Israel, persist in targeting nuclear facilities, ballistic missiles, drones, and Strait of Hormuz threats despite President Trump's repeated signals of an imminent conclusion, including claims of 80% destruction of Iranian missile bases. No formal end announcement has materialized, with trader consensus reflecting uncertainty amid a looming 60-day War Powers Resolution deadline around May 1 and ongoing mine-clearing efforts. On April 28, US intelligence assessed Iran's reaction to a potential Trump victory declaration, while indirect talks hosted by Pakistan face hurdles over nuclear restrictions and sanctions, potentially tipping toward de-escalation or prolonged engagement.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran peace talks remain stalled after President Trump rejected Tehran's initial proposal last week, with Iran now preparing a revised offer amid a US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz that has driven oil prices above $110 per barrel. A fragile two-week ceasefire, extended since April 7 following the 2026 Iran war's Operation Epic Fury, holds tenuously as delegations prepare for renewed direct negotiations in Islamabad, Pakistan. Key sticking points include Iran's nuclear program, ballistic missiles, sanctions relief, proxy activities, and unrestricted Hormuz shipping. Diplomatic rhetoric has escalated, with Trump claiming Iran is in "collapse," while ongoing Israel-Hezbollah clashes risk spillover. Traders weigh these tensions against momentum for a deal by summer, with next talks pivotal for de-escalation or breakdown.

title: Who will be confirmed as Fed Chair?
description:
This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump's nominee Kevin Warsh holds commanding trader consensus at 98.7% for Federal Reserve Chair confirmation, driven by procedural momentum following his April 21 Senate Banking Committee hearing where he pledged monetary policy independence amid concerns over White House influence on interest rates. Key Republican Sen. Thom Tillis lifted his hold on April 27 after DOJ resolutions tied to Jerome Powell, clearing the path for a committee advancement vote on April 29 and full Senate consideration before Powell's May 15 term end. Strong GOP support and historical confirmation patterns for nominees bolster odds, though late-breaking scandals, bipartisan defections, financial disclosure issues, or withdrawal could disrupt the outcome.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus reflects near-certainty that the Iranian regime will endure past May 31, driven by its sustained control amid the ongoing US-Iran war and 2025-2026 protests. Recent executions of anti-regime figures in early April and mass arrests have quelled potential uprisings, while the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) remains loyal despite airstrikes and leadership transition following Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's reported assassination, with Mojtaba Khamenei consolidating power as new supreme leader. No verified defections or territorial losses signal collapse, echoing historical resilience against dissent. eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim edge over California Governor Gavin Newsom in trader consensus for the 2028 presidential election winner, reflecting his incumbency advantage as Trump's running mate and recent polling leads, including a late-March UMass Lowell survey showing Vance at 33% to Newsom's 30%. Vance's high-profile donor outreach with major Republican billionaires and top CPAC straw poll finish have solidified his frontrunner status, while Newsom benefits from Democratic field fragmentation post-Harris. Secretary of State Marco Rubio trails closely at third amid visibility gains on foreign policy, including Iran tensions. The race remains tightly contested ahead of 2026 midterms, which could shift momentum via swing state results, primary endorsements, or administration performance metrics.

title: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in April 2026?
description: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in April 2026?

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $160 in April?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point during April 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For WTI futures, the active month refers to the nearest listed contract month. The active month changes at 6:00:00 PM ET at the start of the trading session two business days prior to that contract's last trading day, at which point the next listed contract becomes the active month.

For WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, the last trading day is defined as three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day), consistent with CME contract specifications.

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours as listed on Pyth.

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the Active Month WTI Crude Oil futures "High" prices available at https://pythdata.app/explore?search=WTI, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles.

Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's duo Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen lead trader consensus at 35.5% implied probability for Eurovision 2026 victory with their violin-driven pop anthem "Liekinheitin," a UMK national final winner blending classical flair and high-energy hooks that dominate fan polls, bookie odds, and jury predictions for broad appeal across televote and jury splits. Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund follows at 12.3% with the emotive ballad "Før vi går hjem," buoyed by strong Melodi Grand Prix momentum despite mixed pre-party feedback questioning top-three contention. Greece's Akylas sits at 10.8% after unveiling a pumped-up "Super Ferto" remix last week, while France's internally selected Monroe holds 10.2% on "Regarde!"'s chic Parisian vibe. First rehearsals kick off this week in Vienna ahead of semis on May 12/14 and final on May 16, where staging and live vocals could spark momentum shifts in this crowded field.

eventMetadata.context_description: In Game 5 of their tied 2-2 first-round Eastern Conference playoff series, the New York Knicks host the Atlanta Hawks at Madison Square Garden, where homecourt advantage and crowd energy could prove decisive. The Knicks reclaimed momentum with a Game 4 victory despite Jalen Brunson tweaking his left ankle in the third quarter—his status remains a key watch on the latest injury report, alongside a fully healthy supporting cast featuring Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby, Josh Hart, Karl-Anthony Towns, and Mitchell Robinson. Atlanta continues without backup center Jock Landale (high ankle sprain), straining Onyeka Okongwu's minutes in the frontcourt alongside Jalen Johnson, Jonathan Kuminga, and CJ McCollum. Hawks' fast-paced screening actions challenged Knicks' rotations earlier, but New York's defensive versatility and rest edge post-Game 4 tilt trader consensus toward a closely contested battle.

title: US x Iran diplomatic meeting by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Amid stalled US-Iran peace negotiations following the April 11-12 Islamabad talks—the highest-level direct engagement since 1979, led by Vice President JD Vance and Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf—traders weigh prospects for renewed diplomacy. Those marathon sessions yielded no deal on ceasefire terms, nuclear constraints, or Strait of Hormuz access, prompting a US naval blockade and Iranian retaliation threats. President Trump canceled envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner's planned Pakistan trip on April 25 after Tehran refused direct talks. Iran submitted a new proposal via Pakistan yesterday to reopen the strait and end hostilities while postponing nuclear discussions; the White House is reviewing it skeptically amid Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's Moscow visit blaming US demands. No next-round date is set, with Hormuz tensions and global economic pressures as key catalysts.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Boston Celtics hold a commanding 3-1 series lead over the Philadelphia 76ers in their Eastern Conference first-round NBA playoffs matchup, with Game 5 set for TD Garden on April 28. Boston's trader-favored status stems from their dominant 128-96 Game 4 blowout on April 26—despite Joel Embiid's return from an April appendectomy—highlighted by a franchise playoff-record 24 three-pointers and Payton Pritchard's career-high 32 points. The Celtics report no injuries, enjoying full health and home-court advantage, while Embiid is probable but rusty after a month sidelined. Philadelphia faces elimination pressure, needing a road upset amid Boston's superior recent form, three-point barrage, and rest edge from the regular season's 56-26 record versus Philly's 45-37.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of April?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and April 30, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for April 30, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices a 99.6% implied probability against Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic normalizing by April 30, reflecting persistent U.S. naval blockade of Iranian vessels—enforced since April 13—and Iranian restrictions amid stalled ceasefire talks, as confirmed by Reuters data showing just 3-7 transits daily versus a pre-crisis baseline of 120-140. eventMetadata.context_description: Fnatic holds a clear edge in trader consensus for their BO3 upper bracket opener against Shifters in the Esports World Cup 2026 EMEA Qualifier double-elimination playoffs, stemming from a dominant 2-0 sweep over Shifters in LEC Spring Week 5 Day 1 just four days ago, boosting Fnatic's record to 2-3 amid their mid-pack struggle. Shifters, mired at 0-5 with two wins in their last 10 LEC matches, announced jungler Sheo's return yesterday as a substitute for Boukada—reuniting the experienced Frenchman (2021-2024 Shifters alum) with Rooster, nuc, Paduck, and Trymbi on Patch 26.08. Fnatic's Empyros, Razork, Vladi, Upset, and Lospa benefit from recent momentum, including an upset over G2, though Shifters' revenge motive and Sheo's macro prowess add upset potential in this win-or-lower bracket clash, with top two advancing to EWC Riyadh.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Fully Diluted Valuation of MegaETH's token is greater than the value specified in the title 1 day after launch. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No."

For the purposes of this market "locked" tokens or non-swappable tokens will not be considered a launch.

"1 day after launch" is defined as 24 hours after launch. The resolution source for this market is the most liquid price source available. If MegaETH doesn't launch a token by June 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No."
